findings.title: endOfDay now returns the start of the next day
findings.body: The new implementation sets `end` to `startOfDay(day)` and then adds one day, so `endOfDay(day)` returns the start of the next day instead of the end of the current day. This breaks the function's contract and will cause downstream code to miss the last millisecond of the day.

summary.problem: The refactor of `endOfDay` returns the start of the next day instead of the end of the current day.
summary.done_well: The change uses the existing `startOfDay` helper, reducing duplication.
